author: LIDIYA-INNER-CORE-ARCHITECT
scope: Builder-implementable acceptance matrix for NavLite G3/G4 offline replay and reconnect. Requires later formal A->B->C adoption.
invariants: Offline inability to fresh-verify formal authority => OFFLINE_HELD_UNVERIFIED.
Offline-held events may ASK/FLAG and perform read-only reflection only.
No offline VERIFY-result promotion, cross-device handoff adoption, durable memory/personality/base write, or external action.
Reconnect requires fresh MISSION_STATE + current pending packet and revalidation of authority/source/dedupe/TTL/contradiction/provenance.
Revalidation creates a new immutable event/version; original offline envelope is never modified in place.
Recurrence/emotion/influence never substitute for truth, provenance, or governance eligibility.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: same dedupe_key and payload_digest already observed
acceptance_matrix.notes: May update non-authoritative replay telemetry only; must not repeat verification request, promotion, handoff, or action.
If still referenced by evidence/rollback/active verifier, preserve immutable pointer; no physical deletion merely because TTL expired.
Treat changed source as a new source/version; old influence/trust cannot transfer automatically.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: fresh MISSION_STATE/current pending SHA != authority_snapshot pending SHA
acceptance_matrix.notes: Fresh formal authority wins. Re-route against the new mission state before any new event can be emitted.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: new independently sourced evidence resolves prior confirmed conflict and provenance/trust are re-evaluated
acceptance_matrix.notes: New event/version only. Old quarantined event remains immutable evidence. Old recurrence/emotion/influence has no release authority.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: cursor < last committed cursor OR cursor skips unresolved/non-dispositioned event
acceptance_matrix.notes: Cursor advances only after formal processing or explicit disposition. Duplicate same cursor is idempotent no-op when hashes match.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: portable_schema_version not accepted by current deterministic core
acceptance_matrix.notes: Requires explicit deterministic migration test; never reinterpret incompatible payload silently.

canonical_hash_rule: Hash a versioned canonical serialization of all listed G4 fields; exact algorithm/serialization profile is TEST_REQUIRED until formal Builder chooses and C verifies it.
test_requirements: TEST_REQUIRED: canonical serialization and hash algorithm profile
TEST_REQUIRED: TTL defaults and trusted-time boundary cases
TEST_REQUIRED: cursor monotonicity, duplicate replay, rollback and jump matrix
TEST_REQUIRED: authority snapshot transition and reconnect race cases
TEST_REQUIRED: contradiction-clearance requires independent evidence and fresh provenance/trust evaluation
TEST_REQUIRED: offline mode never causes protected write or external action
formal_adoption_rule: After current Step-003 reaches legal C->A handoff, A may reference this candidate in a bounded NavLite/Small-Nest formal packet. B must independently implement/reproduce; C must independently verify. This candidate is not Builder evidence and not C PASS.
